fields.label: Product Name
fields.description: Name of the supplement including its form.
fields.fix: Print the product name and dosage form (tablet, capsule, powder).

fields.label: Supplement Facts
fields.description: Panel listing active ingredients and amounts per serving.
fields.fix: Add a Supplement Facts panel with amount per serving and % daily value.

fields.label: Ingredient List
fields.fix: List other ingredients after the Supplement Facts panel.

fields.label: Recommended Dosage
fields.fix: State the recommended daily dose and how to take it.

fields.label: Warnings
fields.fix: Add warnings such as 'Not for use by pregnant women. Keep out of reach of children.'

fields.label: Net Quantity
fields.description: Count or net weight of the pack.
fields.fix: State the number of units or the net weight of the pack.

fields.label: Expiry Date
fields.fix: Print an expiry date in a legible format.

fields.label: Batch Number
fields.fix: Print a batch or lot code for traceability.

fields.label: Manufacturer
fields.description: Name and address of the manufacturer or marketer.
fields.fix: Include the name and address of the manufacturer or marketer.
